result_range.name: result_range
result_range.value: "rjnx"."match_results"."position" between 1 and 512 and "rjnx"."match_results"."kills" between 0 and 999 and "rjnx"."match_results"."bonus">=0 and "rjnx"."match_results"."penalty">=0

scoring_range.name: scoring_range
scoring_range.value: "rjnx"."scoring_rules"."kill_points" between 0 and 100 and "rjnx"."scoring_rules"."win_points" between 0 and 100 and "rjnx"."scoring_rules"."bonus_max" between 0 and 1000 and "rjnx"."scoring_rules"."penalty_max" between 0 and 1000

tournament_mode.name: tournament_mode
tournament_mode.value: ("rjnx"."tournaments"."mode"='solo' and "rjnx"."tournaments"."squad_size"=1) or ("rjnx"."tournaments"."mode"='duo' and "rjnx"."tournaments"."squad_size"=2) or ("rjnx"."tournaments"."mode"='squad' and "rjnx"."tournaments"."squad_size" between 3 and 8)
